Global Recognition
  • Innovate UK Women in Innovation Award 2025/26 — Dr. Maryna Kuzmenko was named a winner in August 2026 for MooMore, AI thermal imaging for early lameness detection in dairy cattle. Read more →
  • Oxford Farming Conference Inspire Programme 2026 — Dr. Maryna Kuzmenko was selected as one of 15 Inspire Fellows for the 2026 cohort of the UK's leading agrifood policy conference.
  • Innovate UK Women in Innovation Community Forum 2025/26 — Dr. Maryna Kuzmenko is one of 16 Community Forum Members pre-selected for the 2025/26 cohort, advising on support for female entrepreneurship in the UK.
  • Udemy educator — Dr. Maryna Kuzmenko teaches AI in agriculture to more than 3,400 students across 129 countries.
  • WIPO and ITC SheTrades Fellow 2024 — Dr. Maryna Kuzmenko was selected as a fellow of the “Scaling Young Women's Businesses Through IP Mentorship” programme run by the World Intellectual Property Organization and the International Trade Centre.
  • Virgin StartUp Step Up Alumna 2020 — Dr. Maryna Kuzmenko completed the Virgin StartUp Step Up programme for founders scaling early-stage businesses.
